title: Vintage Harkerware 'A Home In The Wilderness'  6.25" Plate Gold Trim Currier
descriptionText: The Vintage Harkerware 'A Home In The Wilderness' 6.25" Plate with Gold Trim is a decorative collector's item from the Mid 20th Century. Made in the United States, this round porcelain plate features a white design with gold detailing, adding a touch of elegance to any occasion. With its American culture and art pottery production style, this collector's plate is a unique and charming piece to display.
